condition: No relevant warning and all route permit guide and commercial controls closed
KNMI code yellow relevant to route or timing
required_action: Apply weather control and document decision

condition: KNMI orange or red warning relevant to route or timing
Required Centre exemption missing or invalid
Event crowd pressure manageable through approved variant
required_action: Switch route timing or meeting point
